title: Yesterday wo Utatte Extras
justification: AniList 117496 has 6 ONA episodes (2020-04-05 to 2020-06-20; 'Haishin-ban Episode'). AniDB 14822 S1-S6 are 'Scene 01ex', '02ex', '03ex', '04ex', '09ex', '12ex' dated 04-05, 04-12, 04-19, 04-26, 05-31, 06-21 (AniList's end date 06-20 is the usual one-day shift). TVDB 372534 0x01-0x06 are 'scene 01ex' to 'scene 12ex' with the same six titles and dates. S7 'Unused Ending' (2020-08-05) is not part of the run.
